name: @pipeworx/mcp-gbif

tools.name: search_species
tools.description: Search for species by common or scientific name. Returns matched taxa with rank, classification status, and taxonomic hierarchy. Use get_species with the taxon key for full details.

tools.name: get_species
tools.description: Get complete taxonomic classification for a species (kingdom through subspecies). Requires taxon key from search_species. Returns all ranks and accepted name status.

tools.name: get_occurrences
tools.description: Get georeferenced observation records for a species with coordinates, dates, and sources. Pass either `name` (a scientific name like "Danaus plexippus" — resolved automatically) or a numeric GBIF backbone `key`. Filter by country code (e.g., 'US', 'BR', 'AU') to narrow results geographically.

name.description: Scientific name, e.g. "Danaus plexippus". Resolved to a GBIF backbone taxon key automatically. Use this unless you already hold a key.

key.description: GBIF backbone taxon key (integer), e.g. 5133088. Alternative to `name`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter occurrences (e.g., "US", "DE")

tools.name: occurrences_near
tools.description: Find species occurrence records NEAR a location (latitude/longitude + radius). PREFER for "what species/wildlife are found near here", "what birds/plants occur around these coordinates", "is <species> recorded near this spot". Optionally filter by a GBIF taxon key (from search_species) to a group or species — e.g. 212 = birds, 6 = plants, 359 = mammals. Returns georeferenced records with species name, date, locality, and source.

taxon_name.description: Optional scientific name to restrict to, e.g. "Danaus plexippus". Resolved to a GBIF backbone taxon key automatically. Alternative to taxon_key.

taxon_key.description: Optional GBIF backbone taxon key to restrict to a species or group (e.g., 212 = birds, 6 = plants, 359 = mammals).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gbif forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gbif pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
